title: Daskam 36
description: Parashurama avatara in the Narayaneeyam, from Dattatreya and the Haihaya king through Parashurama’s later meditation and the retreat of the sea.

stanzas.sanskrit:
अत्रेः पुत्रतया पुरा त्वमनसूयायां हि दत्ताभिधो
जातः शिष्यनिबन्धतन्द्रितमनाः स्वस्थश्चरन् कान्तया ।
दृष्टो भक्ततमेन हेहयमहीपालेन तस्मै वरा-
-नष्टैश्वर्यमुखान् प्रदाय ददिथ स्वेनैव चान्ते वधम् ॥ ३६-१ ॥
stanzas.commentary_en: Bhagwan had incarnated as Dattatreya earlier, born to sage Atri and Anusooya. Attracted to him for his yogic powers, many disciples thronged his place. This was a hindrance to his Dhyanam, So he stayed alone with his wife Muktha kannikai.  King Kaartaveeryarjuna was extremely devoted to Dattathreya. When he visited, Dattatreya granted psychic powers consisting of eight siddhis and promised death only in his hands.
stanzas.stanza_roman:
atreḥ putratayā purā tvamanasūyāyāṃ hi dattābhidho
jātaḥ śiṣyanibandhatandritamanāḥ svasthaścaran kāntayā |
dṛṣṭo bhaktatamena hehayamahīpālena tasmai varā-
-naṣṭaiśvaryamukhān pradāya daditha svenaiva cānte vadham || 36-1 ||

stanzas.sanskrit:
सत्यं कर्तुमथार्जुनस्य च वरं तच्छक्तिमात्रानतं
ब्रह्मद्वेषि तदखिलं नृपकुलं हन्तुं च भूमेर्भरम् ।
सञ्जातो जमदग्नितो भृगुकुले त्वं रेणुकायां हरे
रामो नाम तदात्मजेष्ववरजः पित्रोरधाः सम्मदम् ॥ ३६-२ ॥
stanzas.commentary_en: To make the boon come true and also because of enmity in between kings, which could only be partly kept in check by Kaarthaveeryarjuna's valour, Bhagwan incarnated to reduce the burden on the earth. He was born as the last son of Sage Jamadagni and his wife Renuka and was named Rama.
stanzas.stanza_roman:
satyaṃ kartumathārjunasya ca varaṃ tacchaktimātrānataṃ
brahmadveṣi tadakhilaṃ nṛpakulaṃ hantuṃ ca bhūmerbharam |
sañjāto jamadagnito bhṛgukule tvaṃ reṇukāyāṃ hare
rāmo nāma tadātmajeṣvavarajaḥ pitroradhāḥ sammadam || 36-2 ||

stanzas.sanskrit:
लब्धाम्नायगणश्चतुर्दशवया गन्धर्वराजे मना-
-गासक्तां किल मातरं प्रति पितुः क्रोधाकुलस्याज्ञया ।
ताताज्ञातिगसोदरैः सममिमां छित्वाऽथ शान्तात्पितु-
-स्तेषां जीवनयोगमापिथ वरं माता च तेऽदाद्वरान् ॥ ३६-३ ॥
stanzas.commentary_en: By fourteen years of age, he was well versed in vedas. Once Sage Jamadagni got furious with his wife Renuka for her attachment with a gandharva Chittaratha and ordered his sons to behead their mother. Rama beheaded his mother and his brothers and after father cooled down, he got the boon to restore them back to life. Mother Renuka also granted boons.
stanzas.stanza_roman:
labdhāmnāyagaṇaścaturdaśavayā gandharvarāje manā-
-gāsaktāṃ kila mātaraṃ prati pituḥ krodhākulasyājñayā |
tātājñātigasodaraiḥ samamimāṃ chitvā’tha śāntātpitu-
-steṣāṃ jīvanayogamāpitha varaṃ mātā ca te’dādvarān || 36-3 ||

stanzas.sanskrit:
पित्रा मातृमुदे स्तवाहृतवियद्धेनोर्निजादाश्रमात्
प्रस्थायाथ भृगोर्गिरा हिमगिरावाराध्य गौरीपतिम् ।
लब्ध्वा तत्परशुं तदुक्तदनुजच्छेदी महास्त्रादिकं
प्राप्तो मित्रमथाकृतव्रणमुनिं प्राप्यागमः स्वाश्रमम् ॥ ३६-४ ॥
stanzas.commentary_en: Jamadgni had brought the divine cow, Kaamadhenu to ashrama to please Renuka. As per Advice from Sage Bhrigu, Rama went to Himalayas to meditate on Lord Shiva. Shiva granted him battle-axe or parasu and various other missiles. He killed an asura under Lord Shiva's instruction and became friends with Akruthavranar and returned to the ashram.
stanzas.stanza_roman:
pitrā mātṛmude stavāhṛtaviyaddhenornijādāśramāt
prasthāyātha bhṛgorgirā himagirāvārādhya gaurīpatim |
labdhvā tatparaśuṃ taduktadanujacchedī mahāstrādikaṃ
prāpto mitramathākṛtavraṇamuniṃ prāpyāgamaḥ svāśramam || 36-4 ||

stanzas.sanskrit:
आखेटोपगतोऽर्जुनः सुरगवीसम्प्राप्तसम्पद्गणै-
-स्त्वत्पित्रा परिपूजितः पुरगतो दुर्मन्त्रिवाचा पुनः ।
गां क्रेतुं सचिवं न्ययुङ्क्त कुधिया तेनापि रुन्धन्मुनि-
-प्राणक्षेपसरोषगोहतचमूचक्रेण वत्सो हृतः ॥ ३६-५ ॥
stanzas.commentary_en: Meanwhile, at the ashram, once King Kaarthaveeryarjuna visited and was treated well with riches obtained  from the divine cow. On return to palace, King was ill advised by his ministers to purchase the cow, hence he sent his emissary to purchase it from Sage Jamadagni but he refused to sell it. Jamadagni  was killed. Furious over the action, Kaamadhenu produced warriors from her body which destroyed king's army, still the calf was abducted by the remaining army of soldiers.
stanzas.stanza_roman:
ākheṭopagato’rjunaḥ suragavīsamprāptasampadgaṇai-
-stvatpitrā paripūjitaḥ puragato durmantrivācā punaḥ |
gāṃ kretuṃ sacivaṃ nyayuṅkta kudhiyā tenāpi rundhanmuni-
-prāṇakṣepasaroṣagohatacamūcakreṇa vatso hṛtaḥ || 36-5 ||

stanzas.sanskrit:
शुक्रोज्जीविततातवाक्यचलितक्रोधोऽथ सख्या समं
बिभ्रद्ध्यातमहोदरोपनिहितं चापं कुठारं शरान् ।
आरूढः सहवाहयन्तृकरथं माहिष्मतीमाविशन्
वाग्भिर्वत्समदाशुषि क्षितिपतौ सम्प्रास्तुथाः सङ्गरम् ॥ ३६-६ ॥
stanzas.commentary_en:
Jamadagni was revived by Sukracharya.
Rama on his return, came to know of the happenings from father. He immediately invoked Mahaodaran, an emissary of Lord Shiva and received bow, arrows, axe and left to meet the king at Maahishmathi, in a chariot along with Akruthavranar. After King refused to handover the calf, the battle began with Kartaveeryarjuna
stanzas.stanza_roman:
śukrojjīvitatātavākyacalitakrodho’tha sakhyā samaṃ
bibhraddhyātamahodaropanihitaṃ cāpaṃ kuṭhāraṃ śarān |
ārūḍhaḥ sahavāhayantṛkarathaṃ māhiṣmatīmāviśan
vāgbhirvatsamadāśuṣi kṣitipatau samprāstuthāḥ saṅgaram || 36-6 ||

stanzas.commentary_en: Kaartveeryarjuna with his ten thousand sons and seventeen Akshauhini armies and numerous friends and great commanders fiercely fought the battle. Soon by Rama’s  battle axe and arrows the entire army was destroyed and all his sons were killed except those who had fled in fright. The king of Hehaya then attacked Rama.

stanzas.sanskrit:
लीलावारितनर्मदाजलवलल्लङ्केशगर्वापह-
-श्रीमद्बाहुसहस्रमुक्तबहुशस्त्रास्त्रं निरुन्धन्नमुम् ।
चक्रे त्वय्यथ वैष्णवेऽपि विफले बुद्ध्वा हरिं त्वां मुदा
ध्यायन्तं छितसर्वदोषमवधीः सोऽगात्परं ते पदम् ॥ ३६-८ ॥
stanzas.commentary_en: Kartaveeryarjuna had thousand arms frightened Ravana by holding him under water and making him go breathless. Such a mighty king gave a fitting fight with his remaining sons, but was soon made powerless by Rama. Then Kartaveeryarjuna realised that it should be only Bhagwan. He surrendered to Bhagwan and was killed and granted salvation immediately.
stanzas.stanza_roman:
līlāvāritanarmadājalavalallaṅkeśagarvāpaha-
-śrīmadbāhusahasramuktabahuśastrāstraṃ nirundhannamum |
cakre tvayyatha vaiṣṇave’pi viphale buddhvā hariṃ tvāṃ mudā
dhyāyantaṃ chitasarvadoṣamavadhīḥ so’gātparaṃ te padam || 36-8 ||

stanzas.sanskrit:
भूयोऽमर्षितहेहयात्मजगणैस्ताते हते रेणुका-
-माघ्नानां हृदयं निरीक्ष्य बहुशो घोरां प्रतिज्ञां वहन् ।
ध्यानानीतरथायुधस्त्वमकृथा विप्रद्रुहः क्षत्रियान्
दिक्चक्रेषु कुठारयन् विशिखयन् निःक्षत्रियां मेदिनीम् ॥ ३६-९ ॥
stanzas.commentary_en: Thereafter the sons of the king of Hehaya were in great rage and killed Jamadagni . Grieved at this, mother Renuka was wailing. Rama then got the chariot and weapon by meditation and fought against the Kshatriyaas who were enemies of the Brahmins and rendered the earth devoid of them.
stanzas.stanza_roman:
bhūyo’marṣitahehayātmajagaṇaistāte hate reṇukā-
māghnānāṃ hṛdayaṃ nirīkṣya bahuśo ghorāṃ pratijñāṃ vahan |
dhyānānītarathāyudhastvamakṛthā vipradruhaḥ kṣatriyān
dikcakreṣu kuṭhārayan viśikhayan niḥkṣatriyāṃ medinīm || 36-9 ||

stanzas.sanskrit:
तातोज्जीवनकृन्नृपालककुलं त्रिःसप्तकृत्वो जयन्
सन्तर्प्याथ समन्तपञ्चकमहारक्तह्रदौघे पितॄन् ।
यज्ञे क्ष्मामपि काश्यपादिषु दिशन् साल्वेन युध्यन् पुनः
कृष्णोऽमुं निहनिष्यतीति शमितो युद्धात् कुमारैर्भवान् ॥ ३६-१० ॥
stanzas.commentary_en: Rama massacred twenty one times the entire community and then did tarpana to the ancestors at the blood bath called Samanta Panchakam. Sage Jamadagni was revived by the pleased ancestors. When Rama tried to fight with Saalva, Sanat Kumarars stopped him from the action and advised that he will be killed later by Bhagwan Krishna.
stanzas.stanza_roman:
tātojjīvanakṛnnṛpālakakulaṃ triḥsaptakṛtvo jayan
santarpyātha samantapañcakamahāraktahradaughe pitṝn |
yajñe kṣmāmapi kāśyapādiṣu diśan sālvena yudhyan punaḥ
kṛṣṇo’muṃ nihaniṣyatīti śamito yuddhāt kumārairbhavān || 36-10 ||

stanzas.sanskrit:
न्यस्यास्त्राणि महेन्द्रभूभृति तपस्तन्वन् पुनर्मज्जितां
गोकर्णावधि सागरेण धरणीं दृष्ट्वाऽर्थितस्तापसैः ।
ध्यातेष्वासधृतानलास्त्रचकितं सिन्धुं स्रुवक्षेपणा-
-दुत्सार्योद्धृतकेरलो भृगुपते वातेश संरक्ष माम् ॥ ३६-११ ॥
stanzas.commentary_en:
Rama left to Mahendra parvath for meditation. Once Earth was surrounded by Sea water up to Gokarna, he fired missile of fire at the ocean. Ocean diety in fear withdrew slowly, and upon throwing of sacrificial ladle, the Sruva into the ocean, sea receded  and the land of Kerala came up.
Bhattathiri praised Bhagwan for all his mighty powers in his Parsurama avatharam and pleads to protect him of all his afflictions.
stanzas.stanza_roman:
nyasyāstrāṇi mahendrabhūbhṛti tapastanvan punarmajjitāṃ
gokarṇāvadhi sāgareṇa dharaṇīṃ dṛṣṭvā’rthitastāpasaiḥ |
dhyāteṣvāsadhṛtānalāstracakitaṃ sindhuṃ sruvakṣepaṇā-
-dutsāryoddhṛtakeralo bhṛgupate vāteśa saṃrakṣa mām || 36-11 ||
